senses.gloss:
(ऋ) श्लोकृ r. 1st cl. (श्लोकते)
1 To put together, to compose, as verses.
2 To be put together or composed.

m. (-कः)
1 A verse, a stanza.
2 Fame, celebrity.
E.
श्लोक to compose, (as verses,) aff. अच्; according to the Rāmāyaṇa, irr. derived from शोक sorrow: the first verse ever composed, having been the involuntary expression of VĀLMĪKI'S grief at beholding a bird killed by a fowler.

n. (-त्वं)
Versification.
E.
त्व added to the last.

(ऋ) श्लोणृ r. 1st cl. (श्लोणति)
To heap together, to collect or assemble.
